title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Liquid Web /…
description: A reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Liquid Web / StellarWP Event Tickets plugin versions up to 5.31.1. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling an attacker to execute arbitrary scripts in the context of a user's browser session.
